from datetime import date, datetime
from decimal import Decimal
from typing import Any

from models import Address, Invoice, InvoiceItem, InvoiceStatus


def map_invoice_response_to_invoice(source: dict[str, Any]) -> Invoice:
    return Invoice(
        id=source["invoice_id"],
        issued_at=datetime.fromisoformat(source["issued_at"]),
        due_date=date.fromisoformat(source["due_date"]),
        status=InvoiceStatus(source["status"]),
        total=Decimal(source["total_cents"]) / 100,
        currency=source["currency"],
        notes=str(source.get("notes")) if source.get("notes") is not None else None,
        customer_id=source["customer"]["customer_id"],
        # TODO: no value for "customerName" in the mapping
        customer_name="",
        customer_email=source["customer"]["email_address"],
        billing_address=map_billing_address_to_address(source["customer"]["billing_address"]),
        items=[map_line_to_invoice_item(item) for item in source["lines"]],
        is_paid=source["paid"],
        # TODO: no value for "createdBy" in the mapping
        created_by="",
    )


def map_billing_address_to_address(source: dict[str, Any]) -> Address:
    return Address(
        street=source["street"],
        city=source["city"],
        postal_code=source["zip_code"],
        country_code=source["country"],
    )


def map_line_to_invoice_item(source: dict[str, Any]) -> InvoiceItem:
    return InvoiceItem(
        sku=source["sku"],
        description=source["description"],
        quantity=source["qty"],
        unit_price=Decimal(source["unit_price_cents"]) / 100,
        tax_rate=source["tax_rate"],
    )

import java.math.BigDecimal
import java.math.MathContext

fun InvoiceResponse.toInvoice(): Invoice = Invoice(
    id = invoiceId,
    issuedAt = issuedAt,
    dueDate = dueDate,
    status = InvoiceStatus.valueOf(status),
    total = totalCents.toBigDecimal().divide(BigDecimal.valueOf(100L), MathContext.DECIMAL128),
    currency = currency,
    notes = notes?.let { value -> value.toString() },
    customerId = customer.customerId,
    customerName = TODO("No value for customerName in the mapping"),
    customerEmail = customer.emailAddress,
    billingAddress = customer.billingAddress.toAddress(),
    items = lines.map { it.toInvoiceItem() },
    isPaid = paid,
    createdBy = TODO("No value for createdBy in the mapping"),
)

fun BillingAddress.toAddress(): Address = Address(
    street = street,
    city = city,
    postalCode = zipCode,
    countryCode = country,
)

fun Line.toInvoiceItem(): InvoiceItem = InvoiceItem(
    sku = sku,
    description = description,
    quantity = qty.toInt(),
    unitPrice = unitPriceCents.toBigDecimal().divide(BigDecimal.valueOf(100L), MathContext.DECIMAL128),
    taxRate = taxRate.toDouble(),
)

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

final class InvoiceResponseMapper
{
    public static function toInvoice(array $source): Invoice
    {
        return new Invoice(
            id: $source['invoice_id'],
            issuedAt: new \DateTimeImmutable($source['issued_at']),
            dueDate: new \DateTimeImmutable($source['due_date']),
            status: InvoiceStatus::from($source['status']),
            total: ((float) $source['total_cents']) / 100,
            currency: $source['currency'],
            notes: ($source['notes'] ?? null) === null ? null : (string) ($source['notes'] ?? null),
            customerId: $source['customer']['customer_id'],
            customerName: throw new \LogicException('No value for customerName in the mapping'),
            customerEmail: $source['customer']['email_address'],
            billingAddress: self::toAddress($source['customer']['billing_address']),
            items: array_map(self::toInvoiceItem(...), $source['lines']),
            isPaid: $source['paid'],
            createdBy: throw new \LogicException('No value for createdBy in the mapping'),
        );
    }

    public static function toAddress(array $source): Address
    {
        return new Address(
            street: $source['street'],
            city: $source['city'],
            postalCode: $source['zip_code'],
            countryCode: $source['country'],
        );
    }

    public static function toInvoiceItem(array $source): InvoiceItem
    {
        return new InvoiceItem(
            sku: $source['sku'],
            description: $source['description'],
            quantity: $source['qty'],
            unitPrice: ((float) $source['unit_price_cents']) / 100,
            taxRate: $source['tax_rate'],
        );
    }
}
